area: documentation structure: collapse the generated evidence subtree so the README stops growing by a row per cycle

find.report_claim: PRINCIPLE-005's tree rule requires each tracked or pending file in an expanded directory to appear in README.md, and the advisory warned the file was at 35,702-35,781 of 37,500 chars with ~1,700 left
find.live_evidence: the evidence/ directory was listed as one row plus 170 child rows (cycle-01 .. cycle-150 JSON plus before/after/diff capture files), about 10.7 kB of README; every cycle added another row and would have hit the hard limit within roughly twenty cycles
find.consumer_evidence: the checker's own rule (audit_readme) only requires the top-level segment for a directory that has no children listed, so a collapsed directory row is the supported convention rather than an exemption

read: scripts/update_knowledge_base.py audit_readme: required set construction and the per-directory expansion loop
scripts/update_knowledge_base.py parse_readme_tree: indentation-stack parsing of the ```text block
killed: listing only cycle summaries and collapsing the captures: the directory would stay expanded, so the drift class would return with the next capture pair
renaming or deleting evidence files: they are generated artefacts other cycles cite by name
raising the character limit: that is a rule change to fit the document instead of a document that fits the rule
analyze.survivor: collapse evidence/ to a single descriptive row, since its 170 children are generated output whose authoritative index is .aikit/cycles.md, and prove the gate still catches genuinely new source files

fix.shooter: README.md replaces the 170 evidence child rows with one row ('evidence/ <- cycle-NNN.json per cycle plus before/after capture pairs'); file size drops from 35,781 to 27,619 chars (9,881 headroom)

shooter.sustainability: wrote a throwaway evidence/cycle-151.json and the guidelines gate still reported OK, so a new cycle costs no README change; then wrote a throwaway tests/test_zz_probe_new_file.py and the gate failed with "README.md tree omits new file 'tests/test_zz_probe_new_file.py'", proving the requirement was not weakened; both probes were removed
shooter.tests: 537 passed, 2 xfailed in the full suite
